commit.message:
[x86 targets] Better `count_utf8` implementations

SSE and AVX2 yield bytemasks as comparison results. It's faster
to interpret these bytemasks as vectors of 0 and -1 instead of
translating them into bit-masks and using population count to
do the math.

Use correct intrinsic function

Co-authored-by: Daniel Lemire <daniel@lemire.me>
